# `MsgPackDocument.h` File

<p>This file declares a class that exposes a simple in-memory representation of a document of MsgPack objects, that can be read from MsgPack, written to MsgPack, and inspected and modified in memory. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Description {#details}

<p>This file declares a class that exposes a simple in-memory representation of a document of MsgPack objects, that can be read from MsgPack, written to MsgPack, and inspected and modified in memory.</p>


<p>This is intended to be a lighter-weight (in terms of memory allocations) replacement for MsgPackTypes.</p>
